schema.description: The expectation sections, each headed core, additional or plain expectations: s 6 Expectations—provider will take reasonable steps to ensure safe use. s 7 Expectations—provider will consult with Commissioner and refer to Commissioner’s guidance in determining reasonable steps to ensure safe use. s 8 Additional expectation—provider will take reasonable steps regarding encrypted services. s 8A Additional expectations—provider will take reasonable steps regarding generative artificial intelligence capabilities. s 8B Additional expectations—provider will take reasonable steps regarding recommender systems. s 9 Additional expectation—provider will take reasonable steps regarding anonymous accounts. s 10 Additional expectation—provider will consult and cooperate with other service providers to promote safe use. s 11 Core expectation—provider will take reasonable steps to minimise provision of certain material. s 12 Core expectation—provider will take reasonable steps to prevent access by children to class 2 material. s 13 Expectations—provider will ensure mechanisms to report and make complaints about certain material. s 14 Additional expectations—provider will ensure service has terms of use, certain policies etc. s 15 Expectations—provider will ensure service has mechanisms to report and make complaints about breaches of terms of use. s 16 Additional expectation—provider will make accessible information on how to complain to Commissioner. s 17 Additional expectation—provider will make information on terms of use, policies and complaints etc. accessible. s 18 Additional expectation—provider will provide updates about changes in policies, terms and conditions etc. s 19 Additional expectation—provider will keep records regarding certain matters. s 20 Expectations—provider will provide requested information to the Commissioner. s 21 Additional expectations—provider will have designated contact point.
schema.title: Online Safety (Basic Online Safety Expectations) Determination 2022 (F2022L00062, compilation C01)
